Jemimah Rodrigues Injured, Out of The Hundred; Asia Cup Participation Uncertain

Indian cricketer Jemimah Rodrigues has been ruled out of The Hundred tournament due to a hamstring injury. Her participation in the upcoming Women's T20 Asia Cup is now in doubt. The injury occurred during her participation in The Hundred, raising questions about the financial responsibility for her medical expenses, estimated at ₹77 lakh.
